{{Quote|Padaunete and Jonava Billane are currently on Kassido reviewing casting auditions for the as-yet untitled Baby Ludi holofeature.|HoloNet News report|<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|jediwatch/13418_1.html|Baby Ludi Moved to Kamparas}}</ref>}}
'''Kassido''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Kassido system/Legends|Kassido system]] of the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Senex-Juvex Loop]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Manforgon system/Legends|Manforgon]] and [[Ossiathora system/Legends|Ossiathora systems]], while the [[Kassido Bypass]] and the [[D'Aelgoth Trade Route]] connected it to the [[Yhifar system/Legends|Yhifar system]] and the [[D'Aelgoth sector/Legends|D'Aelgoth sector's]] [[Selenius system/Legends|Selenius system]], respectively.<ref name="TEA" />

Kassido was a sprawling [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|urban world]] and had one of largest planetary populations in the Senex-Juvex region. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[House Kassido]] and engaged in extensive [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] with [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in the D'Aelgoth [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

By the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[22 BBY/Legends|13:4:18]], [[Jonava Billane]] and [[Thrynka Padaunete]], the leader of the [[People's Inquest]] watchgroup, were on Kassido, where the pair reviewed casting auditions for a [[Untitled Baby Ludi Project|holofilm]] being made on the subject of Billane's [[Gender/Legends|daughter]] [[Aris-Del Wari|Ludi]] and her [["Baby Ludi" custody case|adoption]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. That fact was later noted by an issue of the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]].<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kassido was first mentioned in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 52|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #52'']], an [[in-universe]] issue of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]<ref name="HNN" /> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]]<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> and published on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]] on [[April 18]], [[2002]].<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6493893|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-04-18|time=6:27 PM|archivedate=20200305125429}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the world in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" />
